title: TRUMP SAT PRIOR-ART SWEEP AND REDUCER-DYNAMICS NOVELTY ZONE
purpose: Preserve the prior-art sweep inherited from the completed chat 'Данте девятый круг', constrain novelty claims, freeze the interpretation of Lane B, and define the next mathematically admissible H1/H3 directions for JANUS/TRUMP.

provenance.interpretation_rule: The literature statements below are preserved as inherited research context. They remain subject to independent bibliographic recheck before publication or novelty claims.

central_prior_art_conclusion.statement: Most individual ingredients of the current JANUS/TRUMP SAT program already have prior art when considered separately.
central_prior_art_conclusion.central_combination_not_found_in_prior_s: ONE FIXED EXACT CERTIFYING REDUCER -> RESIDUAL INCIDENCE STRUCTURE -> either O(log n) universal funnel or a provably reduction-stable wide obstruction
central_prior_art_conclusion.firewall: NO PRIOR ART FOUND != NOVELTY PROVED

prior_art_map.area: BVE, subsumption, self-subsuming resolution, clause elimination
prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Eén–Biere SAT 2005 already combined variable elimination, subsumption and self-subsuming resolution; BVE remains a central preprocessing/inprocessing method.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: R33/R35B rules are not novelty by themselves.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: DRAT/LRAT and machine-checkable UNSAT proof logging are established SAT practice, including competition use.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Proof-carrying engineering is valuable but the generic idea of certificates is not to be claimed as new.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: SAT/#SAT parameterized by incidence treewidth has established FPT algorithms; the prior sweep specifically recorded Slivovsky–Szeider 2^k dependence and SETH-tightness context.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: BA25 generic FPT core is not new as a general idea.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Althaus–Schnurbusch 2024 was identified as a close collision: SAT-related preprocessing specifically aimed at lowering treewidth, mainly primal treewidth, using auxiliary variables/simple liftings.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Do not claim JANUS is the first to reduce treewidth via preprocessing; any novelty claim must be substantially narrower.

prior_art_map.area: Measuring treewidth before and after preprocessing
prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Lagniez–Marquis was recorded as prior work measuring effects of backbone, vivification, equivalence/AND/XOR replacement on size and primal treewidth.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: A before-to-after width experiment alone is not novelty.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Fomin et al. were recorded as studying backdoors whose assignments leave CNF of low incidence treewidth.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Assigning/deleting a small set of variables to enter low-width structure is an existing route.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Heterogeneous backdoors and scattered classes already allow different residuals/components to land in different tractable islands.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Any distinction for H2 must come from the fixed nonbranching reducer forcing the residual, not from the union-of-tractable-classes idea itself.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Autarky theory contains lean kernels and polynomially computable decompositions for some autarky systems.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Reducing to an irreducible core and studying that core has clear ancestors.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Boufkhad–Dubois–Interian–Selman were recorded as studying regular balanced k-SAT; the prior sweep recorded transition context near alpha ~= 3.5 and UNSAT w.h.p. above alpha > 3.78 for their random regular model.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Lane B's regular family is not itself a new idea, and B1 at alpha=5 must not be overinterpreted.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: For bounded-degree graphs, expansion/separator structure and treewidth are tightly related; expander structure can force large width.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: The expansion-to-large-treewidth bridge is prior art. The potentially new burden is reducer stability of the obstruction.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: The prior sweep recorded zig-zag and modern explicit bipartite/lossless constructions as sources of provable constant-degree expander families.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: JANUS need not invent an expander family; it can use a proved family and study survival under REDUCE.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Tseitin formulas already have strong treewidth-related lower-bound literature for regular resolution and some OBDD proof systems.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Do not rebrand Tseitin-expander hardness as new SAT hardness; R34 also intentionally targets affine/XOR structure.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: The Sparsification Lemma already gives sparse/bounded-occurrence decompositions of d-CNF using subexponential branching.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: JANUS must distinguish its desired one polynomial residual from a subexponential OR of many sparse branches.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: Dell–van Melkebeek conditional lower bounds were recorded as a barrier context for strong polynomial compression/sparsification claims.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: Any claim that arbitrary SAT is compressed to a very small object must be checked immediately against known barriers.

prior_art_map.inherited_finding: The prior sweep recorded backtrackable inprocessing, Extended-Resolution XOR/ITE factoring, graph-theoretic BVA and symmetry-as-simplification as examples beyond a simple elimination stack.
prior_art_map.janus_consequence: R37B is an intentionally fixed concrete reducer, not 'all known SAT preprocessing techniques'.

B1.critical_context: The inherited prior-art sweep places alpha=5 beyond a known UNSAT region for a different random-regular model. Therefore predominant UNSAT behavior in B1 would not by itself be surprising.
B1.forbidden_transfer: RANDOM REGULAR THEOREM != OUR DETERMINISTIC HASH FAMILY THEOREM
B1.distribution_firewall: HASH_CONFIG_3 is one deterministic SHA-derived sequence, not the random distribution used in the cited random-regular results.

B2.reason: Separates structural-width behavior of the reducer from a trivial interpretation in which B1 merely lies deep in an UNSAT regime.

sha_policy.allowed: Use deterministic SHA ordering for reproducible discovery and to expose candidate structural signatures.
sha_policy.forbidden: Infer mathematical pseudorandomness, expansion, or an infinite-family theorem from 'SHA behaves random'.
sha_policy.seal: SHA IS A TELESCOPE, NOT A PROOF.

novelty_zone.primary: STRUCTURAL DYNAMICS OF A FIXED EXACT CERTIFYING SAT REDUCER

closest_unfound_form_in_prior_sweep.fixed_reducer_form: exists R in P such that for every F, R(F)=F* and one studies tw(I(F*)) = O(log |F|) OR F* lies in a fixed terminal family
closest_unfound_form_in_prior_sweep.obstruction_form: for a concrete fixed SAT preprocessor, construct F_n such that R(F_n) contains/minors a provable expander E_{Omega(n)}, implying tw(I(R(F_n))) = Omega(n)

novelty_zone.novelty_firewall: The sweep did not find these exact formulations; that is an exclusion-map observation, not a proof of novelty.

target_chain: identify a certificate-friendly residual object H_n
apply already-known separator/expansion/treewidth machinery to obtain tw(H_n) = Omega(n)
h3_candidate_program.candidate_new_lemma_burden: Prove why the frozen exact reducer cannot destroy the expander core.
h3_candidate_program.important_distinction: The novelty target is not another hard SAT benchmark; it is a theorem about the dynamics of exact preprocessing rules.

r0_policy.reason: Preserve preregistration and prevent post-result rule/catalog changes.
r0_policy.terminal_catalog_note: C_USF_R0 is not all known tractable SAT structure; incompleteness of the catalog is not a defect of the frozen preregistered R0.

if_lane_b_survives_wide: Extract the surviving structural signature: separator profile, degree/core behavior, candidate minors, expansion proxies, and which R33/R35B rules fail to bite.
Do not attempt to prove 'SHA is an expander'.
Translate the empirical signature into a new preregistered infinite family based on an explicit provable expander construction.
Prove the SAT encoding, terminal-class evasion, and especially a REDUCE-STABILITY LEMMA.
if_lane_b_collapses: Do not merely search for another benchmark.
Search for a general theorem of the form LOCAL REDUCTION CONDITION -> CERTIFIED SEPARATOR DESTRUCTION.
Investigate whether iterative local destruction can be lifted to a global O(log n) residual-width funnel.
post_raw_seal_audits: NOVELTY_EXCLUSION_MAP_R1: candidate lemma <-> closest known work <-> exact distinction <-> remaining proof burden

HEURISTIC STRUCTURAL SIGNATURE -> FORMAL FAMILY -> PROOF, NEVER HEURISTIC -> THEOREM

publication_claim_boundary.do_not_say: Our reducer is more powerful than SAT preprocessing, or we are first to lower treewidth via preprocessing.
publication_claim_boundary.preferred_scoped_claim: We study the mathematical dynamics of one immutable proof-carrying exact reducer relative to residual structural width.
publication_claim_boundary.proof_requirement: Any novelty statement requires a fresh bibliographic exclusion check plus the relevant formal proof/certificate and independent replay.
